name: Adobe Target
description: Adobe Target is an enterprise experimentation and personalization platform for A/B tests, experience targeting, automated personalization, multivariate tests, recommendations, audiences, offers, and activity reporting.
agentUseSummary: Add one customer-owned Adobe OAuth server-to-server credential bound to a Target tenant and read-only product profile. Selected agents can list only bounded, minimized activity metadata. Relay blocks definitions, content, reports, profiles, administration, and every mutation.

credentialRequirements.name: ADOBE_TARGET_TENANT
credentialRequirements.label: Adobe Target tenant code
credentialRequirements.helpText: The Target account tenant code used in mc.adobe.io API paths; enter the code only, not a URL.

credentialRequirements.name: ADOBE_TARGET_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Adobe OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Client ID for a customer-owned OAuth server-to-server credential assigned a read-only Target product profile.

credentialRequirements.name: ADOBE_TARGET_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Adobe OAuth client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Client secret stored encrypted and submitted only to Adobe IMS.

credentialRequirements.name: ADOBE_TARGET_SCOPES
credentialRequirements.label: Adobe OAuth server-to-server scopes
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the exact comma-separated scopes shown for this Target credential in Adobe Developer Console.

capabilities.label: Read experimentation activities
capabilities.description: List a bounded, minimized directory of activities visible to the configured Adobe Target product profile.

allowed.label: List Adobe Target activities
allowed.description: List up to 20 minimized activity metadata records from the bound Target tenant.

blocked.label: Inspect content or change Adobe Target
blocked.description: Activity definitions, experiences, offers, audiences, reports, profiles, properties, environments, recommendations, batch operations, administration, and all mutations are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One bounded activity-directory read runs directly. Activity content, reports, profiles, administration, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway obtains short-lived tokens for one exact Adobe Target tenant and exposes only a bounded activity-directory wrapper.
Railway obtains short-lived tokens for one exact Adobe Target tenant and exposes only a bounded activity-directory wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer has supplied an Adobe OAuth server-to-server credential assigned a least-privilege Target product profile and one exact tenant, and the credential lifecycle and non-production acceptance have not been validated.
providerSetup.nextAction: An Adobe administrator creates an OAuth server-to-server credential for Target, assigns the narrowest product profile that can list activities, records the tenant and exact scopes, stores all values through Relay's encrypted credential flow, then validates token renewal, bounded activity reads, disconnect, secret rotation/revocation, rate limiting, and post-disconnect denial in non-production.

evidence.supports: Adobe documents Developer Console authentication for Target Admin APIs and migration to OAuth server-to-server credentials.
Adobe documents the client-credentials form POST to the fixed IMS token endpoint, exact credential scopes, token expiry, and server-side secret handling.
Adobe documents tenant-bound Target Admin APIs, bearer and x-api-key headers, versioned media types, and authenticated activity administration.
Adobe's Target API reference documents GET activity listing with limit and offset parameters; the provider redirects this reference to current Experience League documentation.
Adobe documents a 50-calls-per-minute limit for Target Admin, Reporting, and bulk profile update APIs.
